plan.title: Fitness Program Results Summary
plan.subtitle: Key metrics and trends from baseline to endline assessments

panels.title: Total children
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT "Child ID" FROM baseline UNION ALL SELECT "Child ID" FROM endline) t

panels.title: Average score by location
panels.sql: SELECT "Location", AVG("Shuttle run sec") AS avg_score FROM (SELECT "Location", "Shuttle run sec" FROM baseline UNION ALL SELECT "Location", "Shuttle run sec" FROM endline) t GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Monthly trend in sit-ups
panels.sql: SELECT month, SUM("Sit ups") AS total FROM (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', "DOB") AS month, "Sit ups" FROM baseline UNION ALL SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', "DOB") AS month, "Sit ups" FROM endline) t GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 10 locations by child count
panels.sql: SELECT "Location", COUNT(*) AS child_count FROM (SELECT "Location" FROM baseline UNION ALL SELECT "Location" FROM endline) t GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: The program tracked {{p1}} children across {{p4.n}} locations. Average shuttle run times varied by location, with {{p2.x}} showing the most improvement. Monthly sit-up trends indicate {{p3.y}} increased by {{p3.n}} over time. The top location was {{p4.x}} with {{p4.n}} participants.
